title: Application Logging Entity
description: Common properties shared by all logging systems (rsyslog, syslog-ng, journald, logrotate).

max_size.description: Max log file size before rotation (e.g., "100M", "1G").

retention_days.description: Number of days to keep logs before deletion.

remote_target.description: Remote syslog target for forwarding logs.

host.description: Remote syslog server hostname or IP.
